title: Accelerating the Adoption of Residential Solar Power Systems: Policy Analysis using a Dynamic Structural Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.23796v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Problem definition: Solar electricity generation is a strategic component of energy portfolios designed to meet growing demand and reduce carbon emissions. Governments and municipalities encourage household photovoltaic (PV) adoption through upfront rebates and tax credits. Limited budgets require principled, data-driven policies that account for the drivers of adoption and the effects of incentives on adoption rates.   Methodology/results: We develop a dynamic structural model of residential PV diffusion based on adoption decisions by forward-looking households that weigh the economic trade-offs between installing now and later. Adoption depends on return on investment and influence from neighboring adopters. The model segments households by home value and urbanization level, incorporates unobserved heterogeneity, and captures spatiotemporal installation dynamics. translated_title: 加速住宅太阳能电力系统采用：基于动态结构模型的政策分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23796v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：问题定义：太阳能发电是旨在满足日益增长的电力需求和减少碳排放的能源组合的战略组成部分。政府和市政当局通过前期回扣和税收抵免鼓励家庭光伏（PV）采用。有限的预算要求基于原则的、数据驱动的政策，这些政策需考虑采用的驱动因素和激励措施对采用率的影响。方法/结果：我们开发了一个住宅光伏扩散的动态结构模型，基于前瞻性家庭的采用决策，这些家庭权衡现在安装与稍后安装之间的经济取舍。采用取决于投资回报和邻近采用者的影响。该模型按房屋价值和城市化水平细分家庭，纳入未观察到的异质性，并捕捉时空安装动态。我们使用贝叶斯方法和详细的家庭级数据估计模型。
tldr: 本文提出一个动态结构模型，分析家庭光伏采用决策及其驱动因素，为政策制定者提供数据驱动的激励政策优化建议。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a dynamic structural model to analyze household photovoltaic adoption decisions and their drivers, offering data-driven policy recommendations for optimizing incentive programs.
